package q3format

import (
	"bytes"
	stdhex "encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
	"github.com/unicitynetwork/bft-go-base/types"
)

// Appends the typed proof-decode parity cases (ureth C2a) to the committed go-lineage-vectors.json without regenerating it (the
// signers are random): `Q3_APPEND_RUST_VECTORS=/path/go-lineage-vectors.json go test ./q3format -run TestAppendRustVectors`.
// Each case patches the wire bytes of the committed first-link proof; the production Go verifier classifies the result, and the
// Rust verifier must reach the same sentinel from the same bytes.

func TestAppendRustVectors(t *testing.T) {
	path := os.Getenv("Q3_APPEND_RUST_VECTORS")
	if path == "" {
		t.Skip("set Q3_APPEND_RUST_VECTORS to the committed vector file")
	}
	file, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	var doc map[string]any
	require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(file, &doc))
	var world map[string]any
	for _, w := range doc["worlds"].([]any) {
		if w.(map[string]any)["name"] == "genesis-start-0" {
			world = w.(map[string]any)
		}
	}
	require.NotNil(t, world)
	gen, err := stdhex.DecodeString(world["genesisTrustBase"].(string))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	var tb types.RootTrustBaseV1
	require.NoError(t, types.Cbor.Unmarshal(gen, &tb))
	h, err := NewHistory(&tb)
	require.NoError(t, err)

	cases := world["cases"].([]any)
	first := cases[0].(map[string]any)
	require.Equal(t, "positive: first V3 link over the genesis", first["name"])
	raw, err := stdhex.DecodeString(first["envelope"].(string))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	e, err := DecodeEnvelope(raw)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	proof := e.Links[0].Proof
	p, err := decodeProof(proof)
	require.NoError(t, err)

	classifyEnv := func(raw []byte) string {
		e, err := DecodeEnvelope(raw)
		if err != nil {
			return classify(err)
		}
		_, err = h.VerifyEnvelope(e)
		return classify(err)
	}
	withProof := func(patched []byte) []byte {
		l := e.Links[0]
		l.Proof = patched
		out := e
		out.Links = []Link{l}
		return wireEnvelope(out)
	}
	// replaces the one occurrence of old in the proof
	patch := func(old, repl []byte) []byte {
		require.Equal(t, 1, bytes.Count(proof, old))
		return bytes.Replace(proof, old, repl, 1)
	}
	// the embedded seal is [tag, 1, network, ...]: version 1 then the network as the next items of the 8-item array
	seal, err := types.Cbor.Marshal(p.CommitQC.LedgerCommitInfo)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	hdr := []byte{0x88, 0x01, 0x05}
	i := bytes.Index(seal, hdr)
	require.Positive(t, i)
	sealWithNetwork := func(enc ...byte) []byte {
		return append(append(append([]byte(nil), seal[:i+2]...), enc...), seal[i+3:]...)
	}
	sig, err := types.Cbor.Marshal(p.CommitQC.Signatures["a"])
	require.NoError(t, err)
	signerA := []byte{0x61, 0x61}

	add := func(name string, patched []byte) {
		raw := withProof(patched)
		want := classifyEnv(raw)
		t.Logf("%-70s -> %q", name, want)
		cases = append(cases, map[string]any{"name": name, "envelope": stdhex.EncodeToString(raw), "want": want,
			"detail": "the committed first-link proof with one wire-level patch; classified by the production Go verifier"})
	}
	add("proof wire: unpatched re-encode (acceptance control)", proof)
	add("proof wire: seal network 65535 decodes, then the network binding fails", patch(seal, sealWithNetwork(0x19, 0xff, 0xff)))
	add("proof wire: seal network 65536 overflows uint16", patch(seal, sealWithNetwork(0x1a, 0x00, 0x01, 0x00, 0x00)))
	add("proof wire: seal network 2^64-1 overflows uint16", patch(seal, sealWithNetwork(0x1b, 0xff, 0xff, 0xff, 0xff, 0xff, 0xff, 0xff, 0xff)))
	add("proof wire: null commit QC signature decodes, then authentication fails", patch(append(append([]byte(nil), signerA...), sig...), append(append([]byte(nil), signerA...), 0xf6)))
	add("proof wire: empty commit QC signature decodes, then authentication fails", patch(append(append([]byte(nil), signerA...), sig...), append(append([]byte(nil), signerA...), 0x40)))

	world["cases"] = cases
	b, err := json.MarshalIndent(doc, "", "  ")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(path, append(b, '\n'), 0o644))
}

// TestReplayRustVectors is the Go side of the shared oracle: every case of the committed file, in every world, classified by the
// production Go verifier from its bytes must give the recorded verdict (and an accepted one the recorded identities).
// `Q3_REPLAY_RUST_VECTORS=/path/go-lineage-vectors.json go test ./q3format -run TestReplayRustVectors`.
func TestReplayRustVectors(t *testing.T) {
	path := os.Getenv("Q3_REPLAY_RUST_VECTORS")
	if path == "" {
		t.Skip("set Q3_REPLAY_RUST_VECTORS to the committed vector file")
	}
	file, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	var doc struct {
		Worlds []struct {
			Name             string
			GenesisTrustBase string
			Cases            []rustCase
		}
	}
	require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(file, &doc))
	require.NotEmpty(t, doc.Worlds)
	for _, w := range doc.Worlds {
		gen, err := stdhex.DecodeString(w.GenesisTrustBase)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		var tb types.RootTrustBaseV1
		require.NoError(t, types.Cbor.Unmarshal(gen, &tb))
		g, err := NewHistory(&tb)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		run := func(h *History, hexEnv string) (string, *History) {
			raw, err := stdhex.DecodeString(hexEnv)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			e, err := DecodeEnvelope(raw)
			if err != nil {
				return classify(err), nil
			}
			next, err := h.VerifyEnvelope(e)
			return classify(err), next
		}
		for _, c := range w.Cases {
			base := g
			if c.After != "" {
				got, next := run(g, c.After)
				require.Equal(t, "", got, "%s/%s: the retained envelope must itself be accepted", w.Name, c.Name)
				base = next
			}
			got, next := run(base, c.Envelope)
			require.Equal(t, c.Want, got, "%s/%s", w.Name, c.Name)
			if c.Expect != nil {
				require.NotNil(t, next)
				tip := next.Tip()
				require.Equal(t, c.Expect.BodyID, hx(tip.bodyID[:]), "%s/%s", w.Name, c.Name)
				require.Equal(t, c.Expect.CommitID, hx(tip.commitID[:]), "%s/%s", w.Name, c.Name)
			}
		}
	}
}
